lines.zh: 我贴在河底，几乎不动地滑。
lines.en: I hug the riverbed, sliding almost without motion.

lines.zh: 我的牙是扁的，用来碾碎壳。
lines.en: My teeth are flat, for crushing shells.

lines.zh: 泥面上，我的肚皮擦出一道浅沟。
lines.en: My belly leaves a shallow groove in the mud.

lines.zh: 我沿着崖底游，那里水深。
lines.en: I swim along the cliff base. Deeper there.
Redwood shadows reach the riverbed.
I flick my tail and turn slowly.
There's light in the shallows. I stay clear.

lines.zh: 沉石挡路，我贴着边缘绕。
lines.en: A sunken stone blocks me; I skirt its edge.
I search the soft bottom as I go.

lines.zh: 我抬头换了口气，又下去。
lines.en: I rise for air, then sink again.
I hug the riverbed, tail fin barely moving.
The current carried me a while.

lines.zh: 我从林间空地下的水湾穿过。
lines.en: I cross the pool beneath the woodland clearing.
Fins fanning gently, body on the mud.
Deeper down the riverbed, my glide steadies.

lines.zh: 水底有壳，我听见了脆响。
lines.en: Shells on the bottom. I hear them crunch.
I lie on the mud, a flat lump.
My back is the color of sand.

lines.zh: 这样趴着，谁也看不出来。
lines.en: Lying like this, nothing can pick me out.
I'm grinding a snail shell.

lines.zh: 鳃慢慢开合，水从里面过。
lines.en: My gills open and close, water passing through.
The shadow on the riverbed never lifts.

lines.zh: 这地方有软泥，也有硬壳。
lines.en: Soft mud here, and hard shells.
I'm flat as a stone.
The sounds at the surface are distant.
I lift a fin, then let it down.
This mouth of mine is made for shells.
A good bottom. Quiet.
Something's sinking from above.
I needn't swim. The water carries me.

lines.zh: 你蹲在崖上，影子落下来。
lines.en: You're crouched on the cliff. Your shadow falls.
I'm less than a block long.
If you wade in, the water clouds.
I flatten myself further.

lines.zh: 你看不见我的，我跟泥一样。
lines.en: You can't see me. I'm the color of mud.
Don't reach so deep.
I slip behind the stone.
Looking for me? I won't move.
You move slowly in water.
I ease back half a foot.
A fin is pinned. I can't move it.
I press into the mud, as flat as I can.

lines.zh: 我的壳一样的皮，也挡不住。
lines.en: My shell-hard skin didn't stop it.

lines.zh: 血在泥里散开，看不出来。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the mud. Invisible.
I'm on my back. I must right myself.
I pull back into the deepest part of the crack.
My teeth clashed. That hurt.
I can't swim. I can only lie on the bottom.
Pain rises from my belly.
If the water stirs, I can still hide.
Something with a shell sank down.
I swim over and pin it down.
This one will take grinding.
I crunch it. Loud.
Soft things I'll eat too.
The taste fades quickly in water.
Whatever you drop, I'll wait for.
Not enough to wear my teeth on.
River sand buries half of me.
Put it on the mud. I'll manage.
One nudge and I flip over.

lines.zh: 你踩在河底，泥全起来了。
lines.en: You stepped on the bottom and the mud rose.
I'm flat. You'd miss me.
When the water churns I can't stay down.

lines.zh: 我从你脚趾间溜进沙里。
lines.en: I slide between your toes into the sand.

lines.zh: 泥里的能见度，一下就没了。
lines.en: Visibility in the mud is gone at once.
We bumped and both froze.
I burrow under the stone.
The mud you stirred actually helps me.
I withdraw and settle back on the bottom.
We lie side by side on the mud.
You're a little flatter than me.
This bottom is big enough for two.
Grinding shells together, waiting together.
Follow me. Deeper water that way.
Our teeth are both flat.
Lying like this, no one can see us.
The eggs will settle into the soft mud.
Life isn't long. Take it slow.
Don't go far. Stay here.
I pin it and grind.
I gnaw twice and spit it out.
I flip it over to look.
This will last a while to grind.
I scrape the mud and there's more.
Carrying it makes swimming awkward.
I swallow half, keep half.
A shell. Just my kind of thing.
It sank into the mud. I'll find it.
That weight is nothing.
Something's shifting under the mud.
I only move my eyes. The body stays.
A bloody smell is sinking down.
I shift toward the cliff base.
Anything too big, I ignore.
I press into a gap in the stones.
It's above. I'm below.
I'll see whether it settles.
I press my fins to the bed.
Wait for it to leave the bank.
The surface stirs; I hug the mud.

lines.zh: 沙粒盖住背，我只露出一线。
lines.en: Sand covers my back; only a line shows.
That shadow — I keep on it.
When it moves, the mud lifts.
I watch from the crack.
The bottom's darkness helps me.
It hasn't looked down.
I edge closer, bit by bit.
Its shadow is over my head.
I stop and wait.
My fins shake. I press to the bed.
I graze along the riverbed.
The mud moves. That's us.
It turned its back.
I retreat to deeper water.
I dart in and bite its ankle.
Flat teeth. The bite won't go deep.
Bite, then burrow into the mud.
I whip my tail at its shin.
That strength. One blow only.
It stamps a foot into the bed.

lines.zh: 泥全起来了，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: The mud's up. I can't see anything.
I dodged, but I'm trembling.
Holding on is too dangerous.
I let go and sink under the stone.
That one I gave everything.
After that bite, I'm not dead.

lines.zh: 泥浆散开，我露出扁平的背。
lines.en: Mud parts; my flat back shows.
The water on the bottom is cold.
Cliff shadow lies on the water.
I'm shorter than a brick.
First I settle onto the bottom.
Soft mud here. Just right.
I swim toward the dark.
Redwood roots reach into the water.
Something's walking up there.
I sink and wait.
Lots of shells in this stretch.
The river sand stirs; I settle deeper.
There's light in the clearing.
First find a hard shell to grind.

lines.zh: 水变热了，我往泥深处钻。
lines.en: The water warmed. I bore deeper into the mud.

lines.zh: 我从水里摔到河底，翻了身。
lines.en: I dropped to the bed and rolled over.

lines.zh: 水太浅，我的鳃干得难受。
lines.en: Too shallow. My gills are drying.
The blast buried me half in mud.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过我扁扁的身子。
lines.en: Something went through my flat body.

lines.zh: 那光透过水，刺得我缩起来。
lines.en: That light came through the water and made me shrink.

lines.zh: 河底没壳了，我越来越薄。
lines.en: No shells left. I grow thinner.

lines.zh: 雷落进河里，我整条僵了。
lines.en: Lightning hit the river and I went stiff.
There's no riverbed here.
